verdict.rationale: Kong is clearly API-first. Routing, load balancing, and health checks are 'all configurable via a RESTful admin API or declarative configuration' on :8001, alongside the Kong Manager UI on :8002, and Kong publishes OpenAPI specs for its APIs. Several individual features are documented as UI-or-API: Notification Hub, audit-log webhook status, and audit log pull, plus a Terraform provider spanning Konnect entities, Dev Portal, and Teams. No source, however, explicitly claims that everything doable in the UI is also available via the API. Missing for 10: an explicit UI/API parity statement covering the whole of Konnect, independent or hands-on confirmation of parity, and a supported general-purpose Konnect SDK (the Go SDK is labeled a prototype).
